task.name: grasp_filter_place_juicer
task.description: Use the left arm to grasp the filter and place it into the juicer.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the filter.
2. Grasp the filter with the left arm.
3. Move the left arm to align with the juicer.
4. Release the gripper to place the filter into the juicer.
